Contact Form Generator

Generate a styled contact form with the fields you choose — live preview and copy-ready HTML/CSS.

Front-end markup only — connect the form action to your own backend or form service.

📖 How to use

  1. Toggle the fields you need (name, email, phone, subject, message).
  2. Set labels, button text, accent color and theme.
  3. Preview the form live.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained contact.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does the form send emails?

No — it is front-end markup. Point the <form> action at your backend or a form service to receive messages.

Which fields can I include?

Name, email, phone, subject and message — each optional, with required toggles for the essentials.

Is it accessible?

Yes — real <label> elements tied to inputs, and required fields use the required attribute.

Can I embed it in my page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with cf- to avoid collisions.
